record.issue_text: Migration crashes with NoMethodError on sites without an 'embed_category' site setting, as execute(...)[0]['id'] indexes nil when the result set is empty (same pattern for uncategorized_category_id and embeddable_hosts[0]['value'] lookups); guard each execute result for zero rows before indexing

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` for the `embed_category` lookup, and later `execute(...)[0]['value'].to_i` for `uncategorized_category_id`, without checking whether the `execute` result has any rows. If the `site_settings` table has no row for those names (common when a setting was never explicitly set), `[0]` returns nil and `nil['id']`/`nil['value']` will raise NoMethodError, crashing the migration. (The finding’s mention of `embeddable_hosts[0]['value']` is less accurate because that one is guarded by `cmd_tuples > 0`, but the core issue is real.)
